prompt: Some people believe that governments should place a heavy tax on foods that are high in sugar and fat in order to improve public health. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Nowadays the obesity is a serious problem in many countries, and the number of the people who have the diabetes is increasing every year. Some people think that the government must put a high tax on the food which contain a lot of sugar and fat. I agree with this idea, because the health of the people is very important.

Firstly, when the price of something is high, the people buy it less. For example, in many countries the government put a big tax on the cigarettes, and after that many smokers stopped or reduced. The same thing can happen with the unhealthy food. If a bottle of soft drink becomes more expensive, the families will buy the water instead, and their children will be more healthy.

Secondly, the government can use this money for the hospitals. The treatment of the obesity is very expensive for the health system, so it is fair that the companies who sell this food pay something. Moreover, the government can use the money for teaching the children about the healthy eating in the schools.

However, some people say that this tax is not fair for the poor families, because they have less money and the healthy food is more expensive than the unhealthy food. This is a good point, but I think the government can solve this by making the vegetables and the fruits cheaper.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that the tax on the sugar and the fat is a good solution, because it can reduce the consumption and also give the money to the government for the health.
title: Taxing sugar and fat
